sources.label: Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang arXiv2609.06905v1 AppendixA.1 Ex22, A1.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p6.1-p6.2. Explicit ASTIS bounded-continuous extension of source compactly supported continuous test class; pointwise clock-expectation prerequisite only.
sources.scope: Retains actual82 full joint measurability/covered/fallback/fixed-parameter commonAE/init/defect/smalltime clauses and literal eleven definitions. Quantifies all continuous real f and all global nonnegative bounds M. No unbounded-test expectation, arbitrary correlated input substitution, uniform parameter event/limit, AS path convergence, outer-state L2, invariance/Jensen/density, process Markov/restart/semigroup/hypocoercivity/implementation/error/cost/composition/main or actual reader visual/main/PURIFIED/live credit.

assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.

The new probability estimates and zero-time stochastic continuity quantify each fixed y,xRef,z0. Every real δ>0 is allowed; t tends to zero within NNReal with its ordinary, nonpunctured neighborhood filter. The positive-threshold tail at zero is zero by retained AE initialization.
The phase-flow defect can occur only after the first event. Neither equality of the defect and first-event events nor a linear Ct estimate is claimed.

The same existential Z precedes every test f and every bound M. Tests are real-valued and continuous on the literal product phase; every M≥0 bounding |f| globally is quantified. This is an explicit ASTIS C_b elaboration of source C_c, not a new dynamics condition.

The integral is over the actual iid exponential clock law P for fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0. Boundedness gives integrability; no arbitrary law, probabilistic convergence, integral bound or expectation limit is a public premise.

The expectation limit is at ordinary nonpunctured NNReal0 for each fixed test/parameter. No almost-sure sample-path limit, Feller initial-state continuity, outer-state L2 result or unbounded expected-cost transfer is claimed.
units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. Full outer-state L² strong continuity, invariant law/Jensen/contraction/density, process Markov/restart/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/cost/main and actual-input composition remain separate OPEN obligations.

steps.title: Keep the same actual probability input and deterministic flow
steps.text: Use the literal rate-one exponential product P, harmonic flow about c=y−η∇V(xRef), residual rate and integrated hazard. The full sealed statement also retains the actual reflection, stopped recurrence and physical-phase conventions.
steps.lean:
classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Consume the actual phase and its defect bound
steps.text: The already verified actual smalltime theorem supplies one jointly Borel Z and every covered/fallback/common-AE/init/defect/tail property. Retain them all. Existing hazard, harmonic-flow and exponential-product producers supply continuity, initial values and probability normalization internally; none is a new public premise.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort⟩ :=
    ActualSmallTimeContinuity.actual_small_time_stochastic_continuity
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hclock := ActualHazardClock.actual_integrated_hazard_clock_laws
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΛC := hclock.1
  have hΛbasic := hclock.2.2.2.1
  have hflow := ActualHarmonicFlow.actual_harmonic_flow_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΦC := hflow.1
  have hΦ0 := hflow.2.2.1
  have hinput :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hinput.1
  refine ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort, ?_⟩
  intro y xRef z₀ f hf M hM hbound
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Prove bounded test measurability and integrability
steps.text: Restrict joint Z to each deterministic tuple and time. Continuous f is Borel, so f(Z_t) is measurable. Its absolute value is bounded by the same constant M on the entire sample space. Because P is a probability, that constant is integrable, yielding actual L1 integrability for every finite time.
steps.lean:
have hZtM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (Z y xRef z₀ t) := by
    have hargs : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)) :=
      measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    exact hZM.comp hargs
  have hfM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) :=
    hf.measurable.comp (hZtM t)
  have hfi (t : ℝ≥0) : Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hfM t).aestronglyMeasurable M
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Localize the test discrepancy to the measurable defect
steps.text: On D_t use the triangle inequality and the two global test bounds to get2M. Outside D_t the actual phase equals the free-flow phase, so their test values agree exactly. The constant indicator is integrable on P. This argument holds for each raw sample and allows ineffective jumps or later returns.
steps.lean:
have hestimate (t : ℝ≥0) :
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
        2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) := by
    let D : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {sample | Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀}
    have hDM : MeasurableSet D := ((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).1
    have hbi : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M)) P :=
      (integrable_const (2 * M)).indicator hDM
    have hpoint (sample : ℕ → ℝ) :
        ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
          D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample := by
      by_cases hd : sample ∈ D
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hd]
        calc
          ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ ≤
              ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)‖ + ‖f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample))
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      · have he : Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀ := not_ne_iff.mp hd
        simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hd, he, sub_self, norm_zero, le_refl]
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Integrate and apply the actual first-event probability bound
steps.text: Bound the norm of the integral by the integral of2M times the defect indicator. Both test integrals exist, so subtraction commutes with integration; probability normalization integrates the constant free-flow value. The indicator integral is2M P(D_t). Multiplication by2M≥0 preserves the already proved actual defect bound.
steps.lean:
have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hbi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    have hdiff : (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P) =
        (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) := by
      rw [integral_sub (hfi t) (integrable_const _)]
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    calc
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| =
          ‖∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) ∂P‖ := by
        rw [hdiff, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ ∫ sample, D.indicator (fun _ : ℕ → ℝ => 2 * M) sample ∂P := hnorm
      _ = 2 * M * P.real D := by
        rw [integral_indicator_const _ hDM, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (((hshort y xRef z₀).1 t).2) (by positivity)
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Use deterministic test-flow and hazard continuity
steps.text: Return all finite-time measurable/integrable estimates. Restrict the actual joint flow and hazard continuity to the fixed tuple. Since Φ0z0=z0 and f is continuous, f(Φ_tz0) tends f(z0). The integrated hazard is continuous at0.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨fun t => ⟨hfM t, hfi t, hestimate t⟩, ?_⟩
  have hφ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀) := by
    have hargs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ((y, xRef), (t : ℝ), z₀)) :=
      continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact hΦC.comp hargs
  have hφlimit : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)) := by
    have hzero : Φ y xRef 0 z₀ = z₀ := hΦ0 y xRef z₀
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)) := hf.comp hφ
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero, hzero] using hc.tendsto (0 : ℝ≥0)
  have hLambdaCont : Continuous (Λ y xRef z₀) := by
    have hargs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => (((y, xRef), z₀), t)) :=
      continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    exact hΛC.comp hargs

steps.title: Make the quantitative error vanish
steps.text: Continuity of the exponential and Λ0=0 give q_t=1−exp(−Λ_t)→0. Multiplication by the fixed finite constant2M preserves this zero limit. No source energy cap, moment bound or almost-sure convergence is needed.
steps.lean:
have hbzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hzero : Λ y xRef z₀ 0 = 0 := (hΛbasic y xRef z₀).1
    have he : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto _).comp ((hLambdaCont.tendsto 0).neg)
    simpa only [hzero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, sub_self] using
      (show Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ 0))) from tendsto_const_nhds.sub he)
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => 2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (show Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ≥0 => 2 * M) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (2 * M)) from
        tendsto_const_nhds).mul hbzero
steps.detail: Exact contiguous compiled proof region; prior local definitions and facts remain in scope.

steps.title: Squeeze the expectation difference and recover the initial value
steps.text: The absolute expectation difference is between0 and the vanishing quantitative bound. Hence the signed difference tends0. Add the independently proved deterministic test-flow limit; subtraction cancels to give the actual clock expectation limit at0. This closes only the pointwise expectation ingredient before the source outer-state L2 argument.
steps.lean:
have habs : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
      |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)|)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hscaled
      (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) hestimate
  have hdiffzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
      (∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) - f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hdiffzero.add hφlimit
